name: erod

EROD.description: fraction of erodible surface per class (sand, silt, clay)

licence: Public domain (UCAR/NCAR WPS geographical input data, distributed with WRF)
provenance: Sampled onto the model grid by the Rust static-fields crate's generic extra-field entry point with WPS geogrid/GEOGRID.TBL.ARW_CHEM, commit 5feccecd63384381b6942371c7a837f66e4ccb84 (sha256 d49c4f277679d73a92e634c3369e9196f788ffeb21dde07c2371ab6ddcfed305)'s own interpolation list, fill and water mask ('landuse' is the run's own land-use dataset, so the mask is the native build's); GEOGRID.TBL.ARW_CHEM:489-498; WRF Registry/Registry.EM_COMMON:146 (EROD, 3 classes), read by chem/module_gocart_dust.F:88-90 and chem/module_gocart_dust_afwa.F. The archive is pinned by size and sha256 in gpuwm/geog_assets.py (door chem-dust).
